settings.title: No wifi, ever
settings.content: The story is stored in the block, so there's nothing to download, sync or update, at home or away.

settings.title: Nothing for you to set up
settings.content: No account to make and no app to pair. It arrives ready: slot in a story and press play.

settings.title: You own every story
settings.content: Each audiobook is a block you keep, unabridged, from picture books to teen fiction.
